title: deployment-dim-sprint-weekly-sync-2024-11-08
content:
Meeting: Deployment DIM sprint — weekly sync (micro-retro + standup)
Date: 2024-11-08 10:00-10:45 PT
Owner: Maya Chen (notes)
Attendees: Maya, Diego, Priya, Ethan, Zoe, (oncall: Ravi)

Purpose: quick status across ongoing VPC/on-prem installs, call out customer-visible blockers, capture micro-retro observations for the DIM sprint (deployment improvement milestones).

Agenda:
- 10:00 — quick rundown: who is where and focus areas
- 10:05 — active customer blockers (priority & owner)
- 10:20 — telemetry anomalies and probes from last week
- 10:30 — micro-retro: what to keep / stop / start for next week
- 10:40 — action items and owners

Standup notes / updates by owner:
- Diego: Kappa customer (on-prem) — completed node provisioning; hit NVMe remapping failure during disk formatting on node-03, fallback script ran. HW vendor replacing drive; expected ETA 11/11. Workaround: staged a standby node to keep the canary service up. Open ticket: JIRA-DEP-2198.
- Priya: VPC install for CartaHealth — recurring MTU/PMTU blackhole seen between customer transit gateway and our peering. Symptoms: intermittent RPC timeouts after bursts >= 10kb. Followed up with customer network logs; found mismatched PMTU setting on customer firewall (1500 vs 1432). Customer change scheduled 11/09. Added a temporary proxy route to avoid fragmentation for now.
- Ethan: Private control plane upgrade for cohort-omega — rollout paused due to KMS integration failing on KMS-aws-001 (auth token refresh 401). Root cause: token rotation window misconfigured (5m window; certificate rotating at 3m). Patch proposed; testing in staging now.
- Zoe: Runbook edits — merged quick-fix steps for 'nvme-remap-fail' into runbook v0.9; working on a small script to surface drive serials in preflight to avoid manual vendor triage.
- Maya: Observability — added per-install KV cache hit-rate panel to deployment dashboard; noticed a subset of installs have <50% prefix cache hit for similar traffic shapes (likely due to client prompt sharding). Will run a 24h experiment to increase prefix retention for those installs.

Customer-visible blockers (prioritized):
1) Kappa NVMe RMA & node-03 replacement — customer risk level: medium-high; owner: Diego; ETA: 2024-11-11. Mitigation: standby node staged.
2) CartaHealth MTU mismatch — risk: high for bursty loads; owner: Priya; ETA: 2024-11-09 for customer firewall change; mitigation: temporary proxy route and smaller MSS enforcement on egress.
3) KMS token rotation failure — risk: high for control-plane upgrades; owner: Ethan; ETA: patch review 11/10; mitigation: rollback plan and manual token refresh documented.

Telemetry & anomaly probes (what we saw):
- Network: increased retransmit spikes on three VPC installs coinciding with customer-side firewall rule churn. Scatterplot of retransmits vs time shows strong correlation with planned ACL updates. Action: request change windows from customers and add preflight ACL check script.
- CPU tail latencies: one onprem install shows 98th percentile token latency bump after cache misses; root cause seems to be mismatched sequence length expectations in the caller (client sent repeated long system prompts). Action: add validation in the agent shim to reject requests > configured max_seq_len and log caller identity.
- Disk: NVMe remap error pattern (node-03) — repeated failing sg_map calls at kernel layer during fio format. Looks like a vendor-specific firmware quirk on older drives. Action: add a pre-provision firmware-check step to install pipeline.

Micro-retro (keep / stop / start):
- Keep: daily short syncs focused on customer blockers; these are preventing slip.
- Stop: multi-hour deep dives in the weekly sync — move deep triage to separate ad-hoc session with SRE and vendor engineer.
- Start: a lightweight preflight telemetry check that runs 24-48 hours before a scheduled install (MTU checks, firewall ACL sampler, drive firmware fingerprint). Owner: Zoe (prototype by 11/15).

Decisions made:
- Agree to add MTU/PMTU preflight test as part of VPC preflight checklist (immediate).
- Accept Diego's proposal to surface drive serials in preflight and require vendor approval for older firmware models (deferred enforcement 11/25).
- Approve Ethan's KMS token rotation hotfix for staging; production rollout gated on 48h soak.

Action items (owner + due):
- Diego: coordinate NVMe swap logistics with vendor, move standby node to active if replacement delayed > 48h. Due: 2024-11-11.
- Priya: finalize CartaHealth proxy route and confirm firewall change completion; document postmortem template. Due: 2024-11-09.
- Ethan: open MR for token rotation fix, run canary on cohort-omega staging cluster, and report back. Due: 2024-11-10.
- Zoe: prototype preflight telemetry script (MTU probe, quick drive fingerprint, prefix cache sanity) and add to runbook draft. Due: 2024-11-15.
- Maya: run 24h KV cache retention experiment on two low-hit installs and collect metrics. Due: 2024-11-12.

Open questions / parking lot:
- Should we enforce firmware gating in automation pipeline or keep it advisory for 2 sprints? (Action: engineering leadership to decide by 11/18).
- Can we get vendor engineering on a standing 30m weekly slot for NVMe weirdness triage? (Diego to propose times).

Notes to self / informal jotting:
- Could the cache hit-rate correlate with prompt-template diversity per customer? Quick clustering test might help.
- Add a small section in onboarding for customers about PMTU pitfalls — copied examples of iperf/traceroute commands.

Appendix (links & quick references):
- Runbook draft: confluence://deploy-playbook/v0.9
- KMS MR: gitlab.com/redwood/inventory/-/merge_requests/342
- Active tickets: JIRA-DEP-2198, JIRA-DEPLOY-2142, JIRA-DEP-2217

Next sync: 2024-11-15 10:00 PT

End notes: keep this doc as working notes; will convert to a short postmortem if CartaHealth or Kappa incidents escalate.

-- Maya
